purpose.zh: 练髋部在各个方向的主动控制
purpose.en: Build active hip control in every direction.

text.zh: 骨盆和另一条腿不动，直腿慢慢画圈
text.en: Keep your pelvis and other leg still while the straight leg draws slow circles

text.zh: 仰卧，手臂放在身体两侧，掌心贴地
text.en: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides, palms down.

text.zh: 画完圈后腿向对侧交叉，骨盆要转前就停
text.en: After the circles, cross the leg over and stop before your pelvis rolls.

commonErrors.en: Making the circles so big that the pelvis rocks.
Lifting the lower back off the floor.

cautions.zh: 髋部疼痛或弹响不适时缩小圈的大小，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Make the circles smaller if your hip hurts or clicks uncomfortably, and stop if the pain continues.
